name: ListTabLabel
purpose: Text name of an open list shown beside the active one on the inspectors, filter panel and trash. Click selects the list; on multi-inspector it keeps that list open. Optional close x on the active tab. Covers the label-only looks, which have no drag, rename or delete. Merge record: from A ListTabLabel (kept; tone axis converted to the selected prop; surface axis kept; closable limited to selected tabs; close x sits outside the tab element; paneDot unified as paneMarker). From B: the text look of the merged Tab is folded here. B's Tab merge is dropped because the label, titlebar and sidebar looks differ in behaviour the user feels.
base: Radix Tabs (TabsTrigger) inside a tablist. The close control is a plain button.

values.when: No surface. Default for every recorded label except the active tab on draft-inspector. Only meaningful for selected=false, or for selected=true on screens other than draft-inspector.
White raised surface with divider rules. Used only by the active tab on draft-inspector (catalogue state 'selected (draft-inspector, white/raised with divider rules)'). Only valid with selected=true.

props.name: selected
props.description: Active tab (primary text oklch(0.26 0.012 262) light / oklch(0.94 0.004 260) dark, 500 13px/19.5px). False is the inactive tab (muted oklch(0.62 0.013 264) light / oklch(0.57 0.011 262) dark, same font). Replaces the tone axis of A.

props.name: surface
props.description: Variant prop: see variants. Raised applies only when selected is true.

props.name: paneMarker
props.description: Split view: blue pane marker before the name; the active label text moves to x 249 (main-window). The inactive tab in the right pane also carries the marker (Reading).

props.name: closable
props.description: Shows the close x. Applies only when selected is true (recorded on multi-inspector and filter-panel active tabs; x 280 on filter-panel).

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Click selects the list; on multi-inspector it keeps this list open.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Close x button; rendered only when closable and selected. It is a sibling of the tab element, not a child.

states: split-view pane marker (main-window; Reading in the right pane)
hairline frame around the active label (rows 4 and 19; styling, see open)
role: tab on the label (proposed; the catalogue records no ARIA role for labels). The close button is a separate button.
keyboard: Enter or Space selects (proposed). Left and Right move focus with roving tabindex when inside a tablist (proposed). The close x is reached by Tab and activated by Enter or Space (proposed).
platform: Same on both. The catalogue records these only on the inspector, filter and trash screens, with no platform split.
open: 1) Letter spacing tracking-[0.01em] is recorded on main-window (rows 1 and 2) but not on draft-inspector (rows 8 and 9): token or drop. 2) Presence of the close x on main-window, draft-inspector and trash is not recorded; its size and colour are not recorded. 3) Frame position differs by 1px (211-308 in rows 4 and 19 versus 212-309 in row 1); unresolved. 4) Row 12 refers to a 'see close entry' that does not exist in rows-choice.json, so the close button is specified only from the look field. 5) Hairline frame around the active label (rows 4 and 19): not a prop; proposed as styling of selected=true; confirm. 6) Thin vertical separators between tabs on several screens: a styling rule of the tab group container, not a prop. 7) Whether the close x removes the list or only closes the inspector tab is not recorded. 8) The catalogue gives '?' components on multi-inspector, filter-panel and trash for the list tab variants; those rows are not mapped with certainty. 9) ARIA role not recorded (tab proposed). 10) Hover and focus not recorded.
